title: Contoh — Kopi pagi
camera: Shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, 35mm lens, natural film grain, real-time 24 fps.

raka.identity: Indonesian man, about 30, short wavy black hair, light stubble, warm brown eyes
raka.voice: relaxed mid-low male voice, casual Jakarta accent, unhurried

wardrobe.kafe: short-sleeved rust-orange knit polo shirt (forearms bare), dark denim apron

cangkir.description: white ceramic cup with a thin blue rim, 8 cm tall
cangkir.invariant: the cup keeps its exact shape and blue rim; the handle stays on the right

kafe.location: small Jakarta corner cafe, teak counter, white tiled wall
kafe.light: Lighting constant: soft morning window light from frame left, warm 4500K, gentle fill from the white wall.
kafe.ambience: quiet cafe room tone, distant street traffic, an espresso machine hissing far away

beats.action: he looks down at the cup, eyebrows rising slightly
he looks up into the lens
he holds still while a small smile builds from the eyes

sfx.sound: cup set down softly on wood

beats.action: he lifts the cup to his lips and sips, eyes closing briefly
he sets the cup on the counter and looks out of the window

decisions.text: opsi 1 dipilih: satu orang, satu kafe, dua shot
